o.text: Borrowed from Russian тюльпа́н (tjulʹpán), from obsolete French tulipan, from New Latin tulipa, from Italian tulipano, from Turkish tülbent (“turban”), from Persian دلبند (dolband, “turban”).
Calque of Russian горя́чая ли́ния (gorjáčaja línija), ultimately from English hotline.
